LETTER AGREEMENT - HOSPITAL SERVICES RATES AND
TERMS
Date: 12th day of January, 2025
This letter agreement sets out how Evergreen Health Partners (the Plan) will reimburse St. Aldric Regional
Medical Center (the Provider) for covered services given to the Plan's members. It replaces the parties'
earlier arrangement dated January 12, 2022, under which clean claims were paid within 30 days and acute
inpatient care was paid at $3,775 per day. Those earlier terms no longer apply.
Rates. Starting on 12th day of January, 2025, the Plan will pay a flat per diem of $3,875 for each day of
acute medical/surgical inpatient care, and ninety-five (95) percent of the Medicare fee schedule for general
outpatient services. Behavioral health inpatient stays are paid at $4,275 per day, and emergency department
visits at 110 percent of Medicare.

Payment and filing. The Plan will pay each clean claim within fifteen (15) days after it receives the claim.
The Provider must send claims no later than one hundred twenty (120) days after the date of service. A
denied claim may be appealed within 150 days.
Credentialing. The Plan will finish credentialing the Provider's clinicians within forty-five (45) days of
getting a complete application.
Duration. This letter agreement begins on the 12th day of January, 2025, runs for three years, and ends on
the 11th day of January, 2028. It will not roll over; a new signed agreement is needed to continue after that
date. Either side may end it early, without cause, by giving sixty (60) days written notice.

Law. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Michigan.
Insurance and records. The Provider will carry professional liability cover of $2,000,000 per occurrence and
keep records for 10 years.
Please countersign below to confirm that this reflects our agreement.
